reason: The plugin is primarily a user-facing DSH Web navigation/workspace panel for Git operations, focused on repository discovery and version-control actions within a side-panel UI (staging, diff viewing, commits, and history graph), with optional AI-assisted commit message generation via rules rather than general coding, testing, or external browsing functionality.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH Web 的 Git 工作区面板，用于发现当前工作区仓库并提供暂存、查看差异、提交信息生成和常用 Git 操作的可视化入口。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Web Git workspace panel that discovers repositories in the current workspace and provides a visual UI for staging files, viewing diffs, and performing common Git actions including commit-message generation.

capabilities: Workspace Git repository discovery and listing (including nested/worktree cases)
Panel-based staging and commit flow for file changes
Read-only diff inspection and history graph viewing
Git write actions via UI commands such as pull/branch/push/stash/reset/clean
Optional AI-assisted commit message generation from configurable rules

reasons.code: README states this is a Git workspace panel in DSH Web with auto-discovery of repositories and Source Control-like staged/changes/untracked grouping.
README explicitly lists pull, branch, push, stash, reset, and clean capabilities, which are repository write/state-changing operations.
README notes file hover staging and diff preview behavior in the panel UI, confirming direct workspace change management.
README mentions AI-generated commit messages via configurable YAML rules, indicating LLM-assisted commit-message creation.
package.json declares a web client plugin entry (dsh client platform web), confirming user-facing plugin integration in DSH Web.
